summary: Tested Excel export for Data Peserta (backend + frontend). All 5 pytest tests pass and browser flow validated: Jakarta Pusat filter -> 9 rows exported, headers match spec, header row is bold with fill 0B6B3A, student receives 403, unauthenticated receives 401/403, status filter (lolos) exports only matching status. Frontend export button visible, triggers XLSX download, success toast shown, no mobile overflow at 390px. Google Sheets deliberately skipped per user note (OAuth pending).

verification_results.success_toast: Data peserta berhasil diekspor ke Excel.

critical_code_review_comments: Filename returned by StreamingResponse download in browser is 'data-peserta-mdj.xlsx' (without timestamp suffix) — browser strips the timestamped filename in content-disposition. Not a blocker but note that timestamp uniqueness may only apply for direct API calls, not browser downloads. Consider verifying Content-Disposition parsing across browsers if unique filenames are required.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 50 test students + demo admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export XLSX for Data Peserta is fully functional. Backend endpoint /api/admin/participants/export.xlsx honors status/region/search filters, returns valid XLSX with 17 spec headers, header row formatted (bold white on green 0B6B3A). Student role gets 403. Frontend button 'export-participants-excel-button' works, triggers download, shows success toast. Google Sheets feature intentionally deferred pending OAuth creds from user.
